response.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT sf.instownpct, tr.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_overall FROM joined_data), type_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_by_type FROM joined_data GROUP BY ordertypedist), filtered_data AS (SELECT jd.instownpct, jd.ordertypedist, oa.avg_ownership_overall, ta.avg_ownership_by_type FROM joined_data jd CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa INNER JOIN type_avg ta ON jd.ordertypedist = ta.ordertypedist WHERE jd.instownpct > oa.avg_ownership_overall) SELECT AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / avg_ownership_by_type) as avg_ratio_to_type_avg, AVG(instownpct - avg_ownership_overall) as avg_excess_over_overall FROM filtered_data
